newsitem.title: GREECE: Airliner skids off runway in Greece.
newsitem.headline: Airliner skids off runway in Greece.

text.p: An Olympic Airways plane bound for Frankfurt with 26 passengers on board skidded off the runway in a heavy storm at Salonika airport on Tuesday, wrecking a wing, airport officials said.
None of the passengers or nine-member crew of flight OA 1711 was injured.
The Boeing 727 took off from Athens and was landing for a scheduled stop at Salonica when the pilot lost control and landed the aircraft in muddy fields.
"We blame it on bad weather and a slippery runway," Salonika airport commander George Haralambakis told Greek television.
Fire engines and ambulances rushed to the airport and passengers were evacuated with emergency procedures. They were scheduled to leave for Frankfurt on a later flight.
